keyFindings.description: Round 1's finding is fixed: at 362ba0e9 a nested item gets the same R3 verdict whatever follows it. But the span-based owner (:1125-1126) now counts toward the parent every blank line that R2 requires between its nested items, so a parent with one line of its own fails R3 once it has 50 nested children ('- Parent item.' followed by 50 blocks of a blank line and '  - Child N.' -> ':1: R3: 51 screen rows: - Parent item.', exit 1; exit 0 at 45697ce0; 50 top-level items exit 0). --write cannot fix it, because R2 needs those blank lines. This contradicts the header comment (:3-4, 'counts a nested item's lines toward that item, not toward its parent') and the test at scripts/semantic-line-breaks.test.ts:134, and nested enumerations are the layout this PR uses (AGENTS.md:213 has 26 nested children). The reviewer's round-1 suggestion led to it. Fix: a blank line before an item marker counts toward no item.

:1121 'unless a nested item, which starts later, claims it' is wrong for '- - x', where the inner item starts on the same line and wins because it comes later in blocks.items. Fix it when the comment is rewritten for the finding above. The header comment at :5-6 (thread PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6xRwLa) is on the Fast-follow line.
